items.title: Sam Dutrey Interview
items.q: That's where I played with Emma Barrett, Gilbert Young, Mr. Harrison Bones, Maya Kennedy, and myself, and Jim Johnson. Yeah. That's been quite a while back then, 29. And then I went with Sidney.

ctx.x: Andre was the youngest. You mentioned that you had been up to Chicago once and saw your uncle there?

Well, yes. During the, it was the First World War. He passed through here. He had to go to the dentist and save his teeth. Fixed. And he went to Chicago and I didn't see him for quite a while. He came down here on the excursion and then he went back. And the next time I saw him, I went up on a boat with Sidney Desvane.
